steps.action: Place the two tall slopes side by side along the back-right edge of the dark gray plate, sloped faces pointing toward the front-left.
watch_for: Slopes must face forward (sloped side toward the open plate area), not backward
Position them flush against the back edge, toward the right side of the plate

steps.action: Attach one blue 1x4 brick along the back edge to the left of the slopes, and the other along the right edge in front of the slopes.
watch_for: The two bricks go in different places: one at the back-left beside the slopes, one at the right side in front of them
Keep each brick pressed against the slopes with no gap
